NEW-lane0.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# generated by plan_lanes.py; lane 0 of 2, est 3605s
W=<T>/w; BIN=/B/glade; L=NEW
RUN=/RR
mkdir -p $RUN
status=0
SRC=<T>/src; SL=SET-$L; PD=$RUN/lane0/run-$SL
rm -rf $PD; mkdir -p $PD; for r in 'c'; do cp -R $SRC/$r $PD/; done; for d in $SRC/*/; do b=$(basename $d); [ -e $PD/$b ] || cp -R $SRC/$b $PD/$b; done
python3 $W/run2.py --bin $BIN --label $SL --clone $PD --out $W/out --procs 3 --memlimit 4GiB --no-cache-check --test-timeout 3600 --history-from SET-H1   --repos 'c' 2>$W/$SL-lane0.err
rc=$?; echo "$SL lane0 rc=$rc $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || status=1; rm -rf $PD
echo "lane0 done $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; exit $status
